COMMENT: A V4 Miniscope driving an Open Ephys commutator, so the tether unwinds itself as the animal turns. No Bonsai needed.
COMMENT2: The commutator is driven from the Miniscope's BNO head orientation, so headOrientation.enabled MUST stay true below.
COMMENT_dataDirectory: Where recordings are written. './Data' is relative to the software folder so this config runs as-is; for real experiments set an absolute path with forward slashes.
COMMENT_commutator: SET 'port' BEFORE RUNNING. The commutator appears as a USB serial port: COM3/COM4/... on Windows, /dev/ttyACM0 on Linux, /dev/cu.usbmodem* on macOS. The port picker in Setup -> Form -> Commutator lists what is currently attached - open the dropdown, there is usually more than one.
COMMENT_commutator2: If the commutator winds the tether UP instead of unwinding it, negate headstageAxis: [0, 0, -1].

Miniscope.COMMENT_deviceID: Use 'Scan devices...' in the Devices section to find the right ID.
